value: R69 advances source reconstruction and editable linkage, but removes zero WebFrank rules. Missing camera-index ABI information was an actual cause of wrong register use and instruction order: adding the target-supported argument makes the current stock compiler produce the exact local target block. Combat's missing real launch vector and source-data ownership were separate reconstruction defects, not compiler limitations. Nine selected source TUs now link together without editable-mode postprocessing; all-configured-source linkage still fails and shared-runtime-state correctness is not proved.
